verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own backup mechanism: server-side namespace copies (`copy_from_namespace`) that work across regions and cloud providers. It also offers copy-on-write branching of a namespace, which works like a snapshot, and lets you monitor long-running copies. However, restore is only implied (copying back from a backup namespace), and nothing describes managed snapshot or restore primitives. missing for 10: explicit restore workflow documentation, scheduled or automated snapshots, point-in-time recovery or retention controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
